The counter

The wall countswhat you protect.

A live digital board in the [[TARGET_NAME]] pantry, designed to count what matters: cups poured, contribution raised, or the line held. Synced with every machine and updated in real time, it sits where staff and guests can see it.

UpdatesLive
ShowsYour numbers

02 / 09 — What's new

The evidence map

Your forest,on the record.

Something very few coffee companies can show you: every plot we source from, mapped to a coordinate. Spin the globe to Sumatra and land on the exact ground your coffee comes from — backed by satellite data, the NGO teams on the ground, and our annual drone surveys.

ProofGPS-pinned
Backed bySatellite + drone
LiveInteractive

03 / 09 — What's new

Drone survey

The plots,from the sky.

The same ground flown from above each season, so change is measured rather than described. Where the canopy has held, you can see it. Where it hasn't, you see that too.

SurveyedEvery season
Backed byHNFW data + drone imagery
ShowsChange over time
Keep going
04 / 09 — What's new

The contribution

5 → 10%
The rate is yours to set.

The contribution moves from profit to coffee sales value — a figure that sits on your invoices, so the calculation is clear and traceable. [[CONTRIB_LADDER]]

The tiers exist for a reason: below the top price, the margin tightens once farmers, NGO work, landing and roasting are paid. 5% keeps the account within reach, 7.5% is the middle rung, and 10% puts the full contribution behind it.

Keep going

Your Cafématic,in full livery.

Servicing

Servicingschedules itself.

No more head-scratching over when the next service was due. Three weeks out, NoFilter’s new servicing system proposes a date to [[OPS_CONTACT_LABEL]] and the technician. One click each, and it lands in every diary. Silence gets chased twice, then escalates to us. Never to you.

08 / 09 — What's new

A new origin

Gayo Lues,lined up for[[TARGET_NAME]].

[[ORIGIN_INTRO]] Gayo Lues, on the edge of the Leuser Ecosystem — the last place on Earth where orangutans, tigers, elephants and rhinos still share the same landscape. Nine plots, 81 hectares, put forward by the village’s own forest-management body and already mapped plot by plot. You can find them on the evidence map before a single kilo is bought.

RegionLeuser edge
Mapped9 plots · 81 ha
Next origin[[ORIGIN_WHEN]]
09 / 09 — What's new

Grounds collection

The grounds goback to the ground.

Spent grounds are the one waste stream a coffee programme actually creates, and the one nobody plans for. We collect yours on a scheduled run and take them to [[GROUNDS_DESTINATION]], where they compost instead of going to landfill. Every collection is weighed, so the diverted figure on your annual report is a measurement rather than an estimate.[[GROUNDS_NOTE]]

CollectedOn a scheduled run

[[TARGET_LEGAL_ENTITY]]
SubjectIs the servicing fully comprehensive?

Hi [[TARGET_SIGNATORY_FIRST]],

Following up on our meeting last week regarding fully comprehensive servicing for 2027. My apologies for the mixed answer earlier; I’ve since checked the fleet’s position entering its fourth year with our supplier partners.

The honest answer is that the existing arrangement is basic rather than fully comprehensive.

I’d rather tell you this plainly now than sell you ‘comprehensive’ cover we couldn’t fully honour on machines entering their fourth year.

The Cafématics reach their fourth year in 2027, which is when our suppliers expect maintenance needs and breakdowns to increase. We can keep the [[CURRENCY]] 325 rental with its existing basic servicing, but making the arrangement genuinely comprehensive for 2027–2030 would require a new servicing agreement. That would increase the monthly cost, while still leaving greater downtime risk, limited replacement cover and no manufacturer warranty given the age of the machines.

The exact cost of that arrangement is still being worked through: our all-inclusive model is highly unusual in Singapore, so there isn’t a like-for-like on the market to price it against.

So the comparisons to weigh up are:

Option 1: Continue with the existing fleet. [[CURRENCY]] 325 rental + revised servicing cost. We can negotiate a more comprehensive arrangement, potentially including some all-in elements subject to exclusions. However, given the age of the fleet, the cost is likely to increase year-on-year and it cannot offer the same certainty or warranty protection as new equipment. Likely > [[CURRENCY]] 450 / month in 2027.

Option 2: Move to a new fleet, fully all-inclusive. [[CURRENCY]] 460–480 / month, depending on whether you choose the Cafématic 6 or the Cafématic 8. Servicing, repairs, parts, replacement cover + 1-year manufacturer warranty. We would also keep one of your existing C6 units on site at no additional cost as a dedicated spare. If a machine ever has to leave site, the dedicated [[TARGET_NAME]] C6 would take its place, so there is always a machine available.

NoFilter’s Recommendation

For roughly [[CURRENCY]] 10–30 / month more than servicing the existing fleet, NoFilter would recommend [[TARGET_NAME]] upgrades to new, warrantied machines backed by comprehensive coverage and a dedicated spare on site for the entire term.

From [[TARGET_NAME]]’s side, the transition is completely seamless:

  • Zero Admin Friction: your existing ORIX leasing structure and single point of contact at NoFilter remain unchanged.
  • Turnkey Account Management: we handle all servicing schedules, bi-annual coffee flavour calibrations, live impact counter tracking, and maintenance reminders.
  • On-Site Continuity: a dedicated spare machine stays on your floor at all times, ensuring zero downtime if a unit ever needs off-site service.
  • Brand Refresh: new machines feature updated ‘Hold The Line’ livery, customisable with [[TARGET_NAME]]’s logo.

Ultimately, a modest increment over the rental rate agreed three years ago would give you brand-new equipment, full warranty coverage, single-source accountability and an impactful, delicious future for [[TARGET_NAME]]’s coffees and that which it supports.

If you think this is a sensible path forward, please proceed with your machine selections on the following page. Alternatively, if you’d prefer to discuss further, I’m happy to hop on a call or come and see you in person.

Kind regards,
Alex Clark
Founder · NoFilter
